title: UI风格#171 - Retro Terminal Green (复古终端绿)
description: 创建第171种UI风格：复古终端绿色风格 - 经典绿色屏幕、phosphor发光、CRT显示。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFO.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green style When color palette Then features phosphor green on deep black
Given Retro Terminal Green style When typography Then uses terminal mono: VT323, Fira Code, or Source Code Pro
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: VT323 (title 2.5rem), Fira Code (body 1rem), JetBrains Mono (monospace stats) - authentic terminal typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green style When layout Then terminal window, command prompts, scan lines, CRT curvature
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: CRT scanline overlay animation, terminal window with header dots, radial vignette effect, cursor blink animation, command prompt styling

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green style When UI elements Then phosphor glow, cursor blink, scan line flicker
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: text glow animations, blinking cursor, status pulse animation, CRT scanlines moving, terminal border glow

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green UI When functional Then includes command chat, boot agents, memory stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: root@system command chat, 4 boot agents (KERNEL, SHELL, DAEMON, SERVICE) with MEM/PROC/THREADS/STATUS/PID/STATE/UPTIME/LOAD stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green UI When copy Then uses terminal terms: 'Boot', 'Execute', 'Process', 'System'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'SYSTEM BOOT SEQUENCE', tagline '// retro terminal initialized //', button 'EXECUTE', greeting 'SYSTEM READY. AWAITING COMMAND INPUT...', status 'ONLINE'/'OFFLINE', nav 'Boot'/'Execute'/'Process'/'System'
